correctness.rationale: The directed triangle inequality makes length sublevels simplicial; degeneracies are exactly tuples with an adjacent repeated vertex, leaving two alternating cells per degree. Counting directed steps places the even pair at ms and odd cells at ms+a and ms+b. The two surviving end faces give the asserted signed boundary. Independently split the filtered augmented integral chains using u_n and z_n=v_n-u_n for n even, z_n=v_n+u_n for n odd, and z_0=q-p. The change of basis is unimodular when the second cell enters, and d u_n is a unit times z_(n-1), d z_n=0. The resulting two-term elementary summands give exactly the finite bars (drop zero-length intervals), plus one essential bar without augmentation. For homotopy, the first edge connects the vertices and the second gives the circle. Whenever the preceding stage is a sphere, the first new cell has degree one in absolute value by the same primitive boundary; for attaching spheres of dimension at least one this is a homotopy equivalence onto the preceding sphere up to homotopy. Its cofiber is contractible; the next cell then yields a sphere one dimension higher. Ties may be separated for this attachment argument without changing the actual inclusive filtration. All finite bars have length a, so their diagonal match costs a/2; the first reduced death and first positive-degree birth recover a and b. Inspected checker and recorded 68-instance outcome; the F2 computation up to degree ten does not supply the all-degree integral proof and was not rerun.
